Subject: POC prompt set + eval dataset collection - next steps

Hi Samir / Aisha -

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC running this month: 

1) Success criteria (what we agreed):
   - 90%+ intent classification accuracy on the 500 prompt eval set OR a measurable reduction in average time-to-resolution for support triage by >= 25% in a two-week test window.
   - Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 320ms for production-like batches (we'll validate on the Dedicated tier).

2) Evaluation plan / ownership:
   - AcmeCorp: provide prompt set + representative conversation logs (anonymized) by Mon 11/30 - owner: Samir.
   - Redwood: ingest dataset, run baseline eval (open-model and optimized Redwood runtime), return results and recommended model/quantization profile within 5 business days.

3) Timeline:
   - 11/30: Acme provides prompts/logs and a short mapping doc (fields, anonymization notes).
   - 12/01 - 12/05: Redwood runs ingest + eval and shares results + recommended config.
   - 12/08: Joint sync to review results and next steps (rollout plan / Dedicated sizing).

4) Next steps (today):
   - Samir: share the prompt export + one-week sample of logs (anonymized) and any PII removal notes. CSV or NDJSON preferred.
   - Marissa: coordinate internal onboarding (Aditya + Dev) and stand up eval env.

Attachments: please attach the prompt export when you reply (we can accept CSV or NDJSON).

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: POC prompt set + eval dataset collection - next steps

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned.

I've attached the prompt export (acme_prompts_export.csv) and a small anonymized sample of our convo logs (acme_conversation_logs_sample.ndjson) for the first pass. Notes:
- Prompts CSV has columns: prompt_id, user_message, channel, priority_tag
- Logs are already partially anonymized; we removed direct PII but left some entity tokens (e.g., PRODUCT_X) - see anonymization_notes.txt (included inline below).

Anonymization notes:
- Replaced names & emails with <REDACTED_PERSON>.
- Replaced account ids with ACCOUNT_### tokens.
- Kept product names and error codes as-is (important for intent).

Questions for Redwood:
1) Does the NDJSON sample format look good or do you prefer a CSV with flattened columns?
2) For the eval, can Redwood run both open-model baseline and a quantized 8-bit run? We want the cost/latency comparison.

We can provide a larger export by EOD Monday if that helps.

Thanks - Samir
Samir Patel
Head of AI Platforms, AcmeCorp

Samir - perfect, thanks for sending. Quick answers and confirm owners: 

- Format: NDJSON is fine for logs; CSV for prompts is great. If you can also include a short mapping doc (column definitions + anonymization details) that will speed ingestion.
- Models / runs: yes - we'll run an open-model baseline + our optimized runtime with a quantized 8-bit profile and provide cost/latency/quality tradeoffs. Aditya will own the ingest + eval runs, Rishi will do model/quantization recommendations.

Aditya / Rishi - when you have a minute: plan to ingest the attached CSV / NDJSON, run the baseline & quantized runs, and return a short results summary (table of accuracy/latency/cost) and recommended config. Target turnaround: EOD 12/05. Please confirm.

Samir - if you can confirm you'll provide the full export by EOD Monday (11/30), we'll schedule the 12/08 review on our calendars. I'll send a calendar invite once we have results.

Thanks everyone - excited to get started.

Best,

Thanks Marissa / Samir - confirmed. A few implementation notes for Samir that will smooth ingestion: 

- NDJSON schema: we expect each line to be an object with timestamp, convo_id, speaker (user/agent), message, metadata (map). If you can't provide metadata as a JSON map, flatten into columns in CSV.
- Prompt CSV: confirm there is a stable prompt_id we can use to join to labels/annotations. If not, we'll generate a SHA1 key on user_message + channel.
- PII: if you have a short anonymization readme (one-pager), please attach it; otherwise we'll proceed with the sample and flag anything that needs removal.
- Files: the sample files look good. We'll begin ingest today and will post an initial status update by 12/01 EOD in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-42.

If you prefer, we can also accept an S3 link (pre-signed) instead of attachments for larger exports.

Cheers,

Aditya Rao
Principal ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
